rows.why: F14 · THE LOCATION LINE, ON THE ASSEMBLED SCREEN. The correction exists only as spec board 2844:12121, whose own name says 'one location line' and whose body is annotation — 'No surface states site / page…', 'The canvas breadcrumb (board…' — so it cannot be cloned in; it has to be APPLIED. Its shape is site › page › panel. On 52:2 the topbar title I682:2570;681:31 carries only 'Bella Cucina' at [180,111065,200,20], 14/Medium. The page is Home (the canvas tab strip's active tab) and the panel is LAYERS — read from the drawer's own header I2102:11013;2100:10961, not assumed, because the rail's highlighted seat is Insert and taking the crumb from the rail would have written the wrong panel. WIDTH: the next element is the 'Saved 2m ago' pill at x412, so 180→412 leaves 232; 224 keeps an 8px gap. The spec board double-spaces its separators, but it was drawn 420-600px wide and this slot is 224, so single spaces are the honest adaptation — 28 characters at 14/Medium sets to roughly 200px, inside the box with room.
